```{r gene_data, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
            sa = 8,
            sy = 0.10,
            outer_iter = 1,

```

```{r eval}
dta1 <- data.frame(SUVR = res$simudata$cModelsim$y_sparse_amy, dage = res$simudata$cModelsim$dd_amy,
                  age_at_scan = res$simudata$cModelsim$t_amy, RID = res$simudata$constants$subject_amy)


ggplot(dta1, aes(x = age_at_scan, y = SUVR, group = RID, color = factor(RID))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  xlab("Age (years)") +
  ylab("SUVR") +
  ggtitle("Amyloid SUVR") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

dta_amy <- data.frame(CENTILOIDS = res$simudata$cModelsim$y_sparse_amy, age_adjusted = res$simudata$cModelsim$dd_amy,
                  age_at_scan = res$simudata$cModelsim$t_amy, RID = res$simudata$constants$subject_amy)

f_amy <- colMedians(res$res$samples[,grep("f_pred_amy", colnames(res$res$samples))])
f_amy_upper <- colQuantiles(res$res$samples[,grep("f_pred_amy", colnames(res$res$samples))], probs = 0.975)
f_amy_lower <- colQuantiles(res$res$samples[,grep("f_pred_amy", colnames(res$res$samples))], probs = 0.025) 
v_pred <- seq(-30, 30, length.out = 250)
plot_data_amy <- data.frame(fp = f_amy, fp_lci = f_amy_lower, fp_uci = f_amy_upper, da = v_pred)

g2_amy <- ggplot(dta_amy, aes(x = age_adjusted, y = CENTILOIDS, group = RID, color = factor(RID))) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
xlab("Positivity Age (years)") +
ylab("Amyloid (CL)") +
theme_bw() +
theme(legend.position = "none") + annotate(
"text",

y = 1,
label = "Threshold = 1",
vjust = -0.6,
size = 3
) + geom_ribbon(data = plot_data_amy,
aes(x = da, ymin = fp_lci, ymax = fp_uci),inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.4) +
geom_line(data = plot_data_amy, aes(x = da, y = fp_lci), color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
geom_line(data = plot_data_amy, aes(x = da, y = fp_uci), color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
geom_line(data = plot_data_amy, aes(x = da, y = fp),
linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.25, 2))
g2_amy
```

```{r create pred data}
data_1 <- generate_d1(n_subjects = 50,
                          scenario = 1,
                          K = 8, 
                          Kd = 8,
                          sa = 2.5,
                          step = 0.25,
                          sy = 0.07,
                          start_index = 1,
                          end_index = 250,
                          target_threshold = 1, 
                          mid_point = 1, 
                          a_thresh = 1,
                          C = NULL)
    
simudata <- generate_vc(varying_coef_code_sim, data_1, 
                            scenario = 1, #iter = i,
                            save_data = FALSE, root = NULL)
    
subject_id <- data_1$constants$subject_tau
subject_tau <- simudata$constants$subject_tau
cModelsim <- simudata$cModelsim
    
data_surv <- data.frame(subject_id, cModelsim$y_sparse_tau, cModelsim$tt) |> 
      filter(cModelsim.y_sparse_tau >= 1, subject_id %in% subject_tau) |> #filter(cModelsim.t > 5) |> 
      group_by(subject_id) |>
      slice_min(cModelsim.tt, n=1, with_ties = F) |>
      ungroup()

data_surv$censored <- rbinom(nrow(data_surv),1, prob=0.3)
data_surv$thresh <- 0
data_surv$thresh[which(data_surv$cModelsim.y_sparse_tau >= 1)] <- 1
data_surv$t <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt
data_surv$c <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt
data_surv$t[data_surv$censored == 1] <- NA
data_surv$c[data_surv$censored == 0] <- Inf
    
    
    n_subjects <- data_1$constants$n_subjects
    alpha_tau_pos <- rep(Inf, n_subjects)
    alpha_tau_pos[which(1:n_subjects %in% data_surv$subject_id)] <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt
    simudata$constants$alpha_tau_pos = alpha_tau_pos[simudata$constants$tau_amy_link]
    
    simudata$constants$n_subjects_surv <- length(data_surv$subject_id)
    simudata$constants$Xsub_surv <- simudata$constants$Xsub_amy[data_surv$subject_id,]
    simudata$constants$tau_surv_link <- data_surv$subject_id
    simudata$constants$c <- data_surv$c
    
    tinit <- rep(NA, length(data_surv$subject_id))
    tinit[data_surv$censored == 1] <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt[data_surv$censored == 1] + 1
    
    simudata$inits$tt <- tinit
    simudata$inits$shape_weib <- 1
    simudata$inits$gamma_weib <- c(log(median(data_surv$cModelsim.tt, na.rm = TRUE)), rep(0, 2))
    
    simudata$inits$gamma_amy <- c(50, 0, 0)
    simudata$inits$gamma_tau <- c(55, 0, 0)
    
    # Need to truncate to respect the constraints of the integral
    simudata$inits$alpha[2, data_surv$subject_id] <- pmin(
      data_surv$cModelsim.tt - 1, 
      simudata$inits$alpha[2, data_surv$subject_id]
    )

    # Initialize tau to be same dimension as amyloid 
    
    simudata$data$censored <- data_surv$censored
    simudata$data$tt <- data_surv$t

    max_t_tau <- rep(NA, simudata$constants$n_subjects_amy)
    min_t_tau <- rep(NA, simudata$constants$n_subjects_amy)
    
    max_t_tau[simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- simudata$constants$max_t_tau
    min_t_tau[simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- simudata$constants$min_t_tau
    
    max_t_tau[-simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- 0
    min_t_tau[-simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- 120
    
    simudata$constants$max_t_tau <- max_t_tau
    simudata$constants$min_t_tau <- min_t_tau
    
    simudata$data$constraint_alpha_tau <- simudata$data$constraint_alpha_amy


```


```{r fit pred}
source('posterior code/real data bivariate plus survival data cv.R')

dta_amy <- data.frame(CENTILOIDS = simudata$cModelsim$y_sparse_amy, RID_num = data_1$constants$subject_amy,
                    age_at_scan = simudata$cModelsim$t_amy, RID = simudata$constants$subject_amy)

dta_tau <- data.frame(SUVR = simudata$cModelsim$y_sparse_tau, RID_num = data_1$constants$subject_tau,
                    age_at_scan = simudata$cModelsim$t_tau, RID = simudata$constants$subject_tau)
dta_surv_df <- data_surv
dta_surv_df['RID'] <- dta_surv_df['subject_id']
dta_surv_df['time'] <- dta_surv_df['t']
pred_listf <- realdata_pred(X_amy = simudata$constants$Xsub_amy, 
                            X_tau = simudata$constants$Xsub_tau, 
                            1:50, simudata$constants$tau_amy_link, dta_surv_df, res$res$samples, simudata, biomarker = 'amy', type = 'forward', threshold = 1)

pred_listf$simudata_cv$inits$gamma_amy <- NULL
pred_listf$simudata_cv$inits$gamma_tau <- NULL


source('posterior code/real data mcmc_posterior.R')
source('posterior code/posterior predictive distribution.R')
posterior_res_forward <- mcchains(posterior_predictions_code,
                                  pred_listf$simudata_cv,
                                  monitors = c("alpha", "gamma_amy_post", "gamma_tau_post",
                                               "f_pred_amy_post", "f_pred_tau_post",
                                               "rho_post"),
                                  niter = 1000,
                                  nburnin = 500,
                                  thin = 1,
                                  nchains = 1,
                                  fullres = TRUE)


```
